zh.title: 星宇航空9月1日起調整超額行李費 改採3區域計價
zh.summary: 星宇航空9月1日起調整超額行李費；改為3區域計價；每件最高280美元
body: 星宇航空宣布，自2026年9月1日起將調整超額行李費率計價標準。新制度由現行的短程航線每件150美元與長程航線每件200美元，調整為分為3個區域計價，費用介於150美元至280美元之間。此項新費率適用於9月1日起開票或改票的旅客。
根據新的分區劃分，區域一包含關島及不含台灣與南亞的亞洲地區；區域二涵蓋美國西部5個航點、加拿大、南亞、大洋洲與中東；區域三則包括美西以外的美國其他地區、歐洲、非洲及中南美洲。
星宇航空表示，因應航網逐步完整與轉機旅客增加而調整收費分區。此外，旅客若於班機起飛前3小時於線上預購額外行李額度，可享有8折優惠。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines to Restructure Excess Baggage Fees Into Three Zones Starting September 1
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines will restructure excess baggage fees into three geographic zones starting September 1.
body: STARLUX Airlines announced that it will adjust its excess baggage fee structure starting September 1, 2026. The carrier will replace its current two-tier system of 150 USD for short-haul routes and 200 USD for long-haul routes with a three-zone pricing model, with fees ranging between 150 USD and 280 USD per piece. The new rate policy will apply to passenger tickets issued or changed on or after September 1.

Under the revised framework, Zone 1 covers Guam and Asia excluding Taiwan and South Asia. Zone 2 includes five U.S. West Coast destinations—Los Angeles, Ontario, San Francisco, Seattle, and Phoenix—as well as Canada, South Asia, Oceania, and the Middle East. Zone 3 encompasses all other U.S. destinations, Europe, Africa, and Central and South America. Passengers pre-purchasing extra baggage allowance online at least three hours prior to departure will receive a 20 percent discount.

zh.title: 航空維修面臨人才短缺 全球MRO業者積極擴張產能
zh.summary: Lufthansa Technik與Safran擴建廠房，以因應維修運能限制。
body: 根據AeroTime報導，全球航空維修（MRO）支出預計在2026至2030年間將激增至近1,930億美元。此一成長受到機隊老化以及自2026年第一季以來C/D級檢修需求增加40%等因素推動。目前因效率低下與飛機停飛，每年造成的MRO短缺成本已超過270億美元。
為因應產能限制，主要維修業者正積極擴建設施。Lufthansa Technik已在葡萄牙動工興建佔地55,000平方公尺的新廠房，預計2028年啟用並創造約700個職缺。同時，Safran正在墨西哥擴建發動機測試中心並計畫增加450多個工作崗位，而FL Technics也計畫為其位於多明尼加的新機棚招募至多2,000名員工。

en.title: MRO Providers Expand Global Facilities Amid Growing Aviation Talent Shortage
en.summary: Lufthansa Technik and Safran expand facilities in Portugal and Mexico to address MRO capacity constraints.
body: According to a report by AeroTime, global aviation maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) spending is projected to surge to nearly $193 billion by 2030. This growth is driven by aging fleets and a 40% increase in C/D check demand since the first quarter of 2026. Inefficiencies and unavailable aircraft have led to annual MRO shortage costs exceeding $27 billion.

To address capacity constraints, major maintenance providers are expanding facilities. Lufthansa Technik has broken ground on a 55,000-square-meter facility in Portugal, expecting to create 700 jobs by 2028. Meanwhile, Safran is expanding its engine-testing hub in Mexico to add 450 jobs, and FL Technics plans to hire up to 2,000 personnel for its new hangar in the Dominican Republic.

zh.title: 台鐵因應豪大雨南迴及東部幹線對號車24日18時前停駛
zh.summary: 因應豪大雨影響，台鐵南迴線與東部幹線對號列車於24日18時前暫停行駛。
body: 因應豪大雨天氣影響，臺灣鐵路公司於2026年8月24日宣佈，在當日18時之前，南迴線以及東部幹線的所有對號列車將全部採取停駛措施。此項調整主要是為了確保豪大雨期間的鐵路行車安全。
與此同時，針對前述路段的非對號區間列車，臺灣鐵路公司表示，區間車的運行將採取機動行駛的方式。鐵路部門將會視各路段的降雨狀況及軌道安全，即時調整列車的班次。
旅客若計劃搭乘相關班次，建議密切關注台鐵發布的最新列車運行資訊。

en.title: TRA Suspends South Link and Eastern Line Reserved Trains Before 18:00 Due to Heavy Rain
en.summary: TRA suspends South Link and Eastern Trunk Line reserved trains before 18:00 due to heavy rain.
body: In response to heavy rainfall, Taiwan Railway announced on August 24, 2026, that all reserved seat trains on the South Link Line and the Eastern Trunk Line would be suspended before 18:00 on the same day. This operational adjustment was made to ensure safety during the heavy rain.

Meanwhile, Taiwan Railway stated that local trains operating on the affected South Link and Eastern Trunk lines would run dynamically. The operation of these local trains will be adjusted flexibly depending on actual rainfall conditions. Passengers are advised to pay close attention to the latest train status updates before traveling.
